posts.title: Reforging the Workflow: Where the Human Goes When Agents Ship
posts.description: Eight months after Forging a Workflow, Forge has a skill that can merge a PR. My own projects and an experiment with a friend changed my mind about where the human belongs.

posts.title: Your Website Is the MCP Server Now
posts.description: WebMCP is the zero-friction MCP. I gave a coloring book app an interface for agents in a few hours on a weekend, with no server and no auth to build.

posts.title: The Gap Nobody Measures in AI Adoption
posts.description: Your engineers may use AI every day and still be far from real leverage. What matters isn’t adoption. It’s whether people have built workflows that compound.
